mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_user) AS "userTotal", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_user WHERE account_status = 'L') AS "userLocked", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_document WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status <> 'DELETED') AS "documentTotal", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_ai_task WHERE create_time >= TRUNC(SYSTIMESTAMP)) AS "aiTasksToday", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_ai_task WHERE create_time >= TRUNC(SYSTIMESTAMP) AND status = 'SUCCEEDED') AS "aiSucceededToday", (SELECT NVL(SUM(size_bytes), 0) FROM edudoc_oss_object) AS "storageBytes", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_oss_object) AS "storageObjects", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_audit_log a WHERE a.occurred_at >= SYSTIMESTAMP - NUMTODSINTERVAL(7, 'DAY') AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_audit_log f WHERE f.actor_id = a.actor_id AND f.result_code NOT IN ('200', 'SUCCESS') AND f.occurred_at >= SYSTIMESTAMP - NUMTODSINTERVAL(7, 'DAY')) >= 2 ) AS "auditHighRisk7d" FROM dual
